verbatim_source_excerpt: **LLY — 상향 가이던스와 급등 후 추격 위험 병존(positive_watch).**
thesis: Oct 29 official Q3 revenue $24.397bn (+39% YoY), GAAP EPS $7.22 (+16%), 2026 revenue guidance raised from $85-87bn to $91-92bn. Stock up 3.19% Oct 30 after +6.63% Oct 29; strong fundamentals but elevated post-earnings gap risk.
counterevidence: Sales growth 39% and raised revenue guidance can support continued upside; current price may already reflect strong expectations and acquired IPR&D charges affect EPS.
invalidation: Revenue guidance cut, product pricing/volume reversal, persistent breakdown below Oct 29 close $1,373.70 and relative strength loss.
entry_trigger: No chase. Watch for a multi-session consolidation above Oct 29 close $1,373.70, normalized spread and volume, and verified valuation before conditional entry.
trigger_validity: 1-5 NYSE sessions for post-gap setup, 2-6 weeks for consolidation, months for earnings thesis.
target_and_stop_basis: Oct 29 close $1,373.70 and Oct 30 low $1,408.36 are reference levels only; need ATR and support confirmation before stop/profit/R:R.
